name: Step bracket label
oneLiner: 2 to 5 glass step cards (glyph tile, label, number) stack in one per beat; a glowing accent bracket then draws around them and a pill naming the whole group springs onto it, and the steps light up together
say: when the speaker lists a few steps and then names them as one thing ("post, track, improve: that's the whole system"): cut in on the first step; the pill lands on the name. Good as a recap near the end of a video
